source.titleAr: ضرب المرأة: هل هو الفهم الصواب لحل الخلافات الزوجية؟
source.author: ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd Aḥmad Abū Sulaymān

summary.en: PDF p. 21: sorts the Quran's uses of ḍaraba. Uses that are not direct carry separation, isolation and leaving (travel in the land, sealing the ears, a wall between them); direct uses on a body (faces, feet, the stone) mean striking with force. PDF p. 22: concludes that in 4:34 the meaning is «البعد والترك والمفارقة»: the husband leaves the marital home, a step beyond leaving her bed, so she sees where the conflict leads (separation and divorce). He notes the Quran uses jald, not ḍarb, when it means physical punishment (24:2). PDF p. 23: restates it as «الترك والمفارقة والاعتزال», the last step the couple can take on their own. PDF p. 24: points to the Prophet ﷺ leaving his wives. Argues from the higher objectives of the Sharia (maqāṣid). An earlier version appeared as an article in الفكر الإسلامي المعاصر, vol. 6, no. 24 (2001).
